messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary slice "slice-21" p95 latency +60% on /v1/generate (ap-south-1). Auto-rollback threshold hit. Suggest: auto-revert to 2.2.0. https://telemetry.redwood/slice-21 :rotating_light:

nora: seeing it. only affects hosted canary slice-21. any committed dedicated pins?

dev-ops: no dedicated pins. looks correlated with a new compilation kernel flag (fuse-attn). i toggled it off on one host; small improvement.

nora: prefer manual rollback so CS/PM can review messaging. we'll pin region then revert slice, smaller blast radius. tagging kate for notes.

kate: got it. draft: "Reverted a canary slice in ap-south-1 due to increased latency after a kernel optimization. No dedicated customers affected." will wait to publish until confirm.

dev-ops: running pin now: releasectl pin --svc hosted --region ap-south-1 --ver 2.2.0 --by dev-ops

dev-ops: running targeted revert: rolloutctl revert --group slice-21 --to 2.2.0

sre-oncall: p95 dropping, looks stable. monitoring 30m.
nora: thanks. hold release window for 1h. retro tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
